Default Ravengard dialogue. Depending on the path, Ravengard may urge you to save the city, and if Wyll is in party, will offer the quest to go to the Wyrmway. Wyll's endgame state is detremined here: He may become a Duke, the Blade of Avernus, or remain the Blade of Frontiers
context: The scene is a hostile, upper‑city confrontation: Cordula Eltan arrives with patriars and guards to accuse Wyll (or the player) of monstrous deeds after Duke Ravengard’s death, at a time when Florrick is either dead or still jailed. Cordula insists, citing Lady Mizora, that Wyll slaughtered his father and now hungers for the city’s power, calling him a stain on Baldur’s Gate. When present, Wyll vehemently denies the charge—swearing his father is alive and that he tried to save him—but these lines reflect one possible branch of the outcome. In other variants Wyll may not be with the party; the confrontation and accusations are driven by the off‑screen deaths/imprisonments and upper‑city politics.
